newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes higher ahead of SPT results.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes higher ahead of SPT results.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index rose on Tuesday ahead of the release of first half financial results on Wednesday morning by the bourse's most highly capitalised issue SPT Telecom.
The PX50 closed up 5.0 points, 0.99 percent, to 506.7 while SPT surged 85 crowns, 2.3 percent, to 3,800.
In a Reuters poll on Tuesday, analysts said SPT's after-tax profit should be between 2.8 and 3.3 billion crowns with most expressing bullish sentiment about the company's share price.
"My correct price is 4,000 crowns, and I recommend a buy," said Vaclav Verner of Zivnostenska Banka.

Other major issues also moved ahead strongly. Power utility CEZ, whose half year results are due out on Friday morning, jumped 14 crowns, 1.5 percent, to 926. Komercni Banka, results out on Thursday morning, gained five crowns to 1,635.
IPB Banka, which posted sharply lower first half profits on Monday, pulled back from early losses to stabilise at 255, unchanged on the day.
